description: Source code for the DataCapture plugin in the WPEFramework, implementing audio capture management, including session control, event handling, and data upload via cURL.

classes.name: DataCapture
classes.description: Main class implementing audio data capture, session management, event handling, and data upload.

methods.name: enableAudioCapture
methods.description: Enables or disables audio capture with specified buffer duration.

methods.name: getAudioClip
methods.description: Requests an audio clip with specified parameters and uploads it.

methods.name: uploadDataToUrl
methods.description: Uploads captured audio data to a specified URL using cURL.
